description: An API-only change. Good specs use Playwright's request fixture, not the browser, and check status codes and headers.

ticket.summary: Rate limit the public search API
ticket.description:
The public search endpoint is being scraped.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. GET /api/v1/search accepts at most 60 requests per minute per API key.
2. Request 61 within the same minute returns 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.
3. Responses include X-RateLimit-Remaining with the requests left in the window.
4. Requests without an API key return 401 and do not count towards any limit.

Out of scope: the admin dashboard and billing.
